description.value:
The human leader of a surface-dwelling Yiggite cult once carried this +3 major striking greater impactful staff as a symbol of station. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy or Intimidation checks against creatures who are frightened or under the effects of any spell cast by you that has the mental trait.

Activate—Anamnesis 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per round

Effect You siphon strategic insight from your past incarnations, gaining a +2 status bonus to skill checks you make to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Recall Knowledge] until the start of your next turn. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Aid] an ally while under this effect, your ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus on a success instead of +1, and if you roll any result worse than a success, you get a success instead. The outcome of a critical success is unchanged.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
